prompt:
Make a NEW KFB soft claymation ink blob character sheet, Geological Complaints. The original reference PNGs guide the intact charcoal-plum goo anatomy, expressive filled sculpted eyelids, cream white sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil, and miniature prop modeling. Exactly six independent footless complete upright ink blobs in a 3-column by 2-row horizontal 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Equal substantial scale. All props held or attached to their own body, all detached droplets inside generous gutters and canvas margins. No stage, floor, scenery, backdrop color, panel borders, text, labels or logos. Smooth softly satin clay with larger sparse hand-shaped marks, quiet cloth folds and clean smooth glass or glossy material. Avoid dense stipple, grit and crust. Keep organic thick rounded goo shapes and whole ink silhouette dominant, with minimal distinct costume or thematic prop. Teeth sit behind lips. Wide range of eyes, body attitudes and mouth shapes. Style and palette: Basalt slate, ochre, calcite ivory and muted fern, chunky carved rock shapes and sparse broad texture. The role cast in row-major order:
1. Female-read stalactite witness. tall pointed blob with round ends, patient gaze and closed mouth. One compact cue: short pointed calcite head ornament and chunky three-bead drip counter.
2. Male-read indignant fault keeper. wide squared lopsided blob, hard side-eye and scowling lips. One compact cue: two offset rock slabs held close with one stubby measuring rod.
3. Male-read long-waiting fossil. low rounded mass, flat tired lids, stretched little frown. One compact cue: small large-spiral fossil half exposed in a clay matrix held in both hands.
4. Female-read geology sample inspector. tall comma, searching eye movement and tiny parted mouth. One compact cue: short striped cylindrical drill core.
5. Male-read keeper of hexagonal columns. round scalloped blob, relaxed eyes and warm closed smile. One compact cue: one small group of three blunt hexagonal basalt prisms.
6. Male-read confused erosion clerk. upright pear, offset eyebrows and small O mouth. One compact cue: one smooth rounded pebble and a miniature plain balance pan.
Six distinct readable stand-alone figures, original archetypal props, very clear alpha gutters. No copied reference costume, wings or eyepatches.
